headline.purpose: The one thing and class names. 1.75rem, 700, tracked tight.

heading.purpose: Every section title: 1.25rem sentence case, never an uppercase micro-label.

body.purpose: Every row, task, jot and anchor at 1rem so blocks stay readable at arm's length.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every block acknowledges a press. The only universal motion.

motion.name: state-fill
motion.purpose: Background and colour transitions when a control changes state (checked, picked, active).

motion.name: ring-colour-journey
motion.purpose: @property --ring-stroke travels across a session: rose to green riding out a craving, violet to amber across a study block.

motion.name: focus-takeover
motion.purpose: Starting a timer promotes the running section to the whole stage and drops everything else to 12-30%. Built on :has(), so it degrades to no change.

breakpoints.name: fold
breakpoints.purpose: Every field goes full width; the rail lies down into a top bar of nav buttons.

components.name: Section Field
components.description: A section is a neutral field holding a 20px heading and its controls. Sections are told apart by heading and position, never by hue.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 13px 13px; border-radius: 20px; background: oklch(0.944 0.005 95); } .ds-heading { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; }

components.name: State Block
components.description: A checklist row is the button. Tapping anywhere fills the whole block with the win mark and knocks the label out; the state is the object, not a tick beside it.
components.css: .ds-block { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.995 0.003 95); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-block:has(input:checked) { background: var(--mark); } .ds-block:has(input:checked) label { color: oklch(0.99 0.004 95); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary buttons are filled ink. The only coloured buttons in the product are the craving pair: green for the win, red for the slip.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.24 0.02 285); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 95); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary.win { background: oklch(0.5 0.135 155); } .ds-primary.slip { background: oklch(0.55 0.195 22); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Times, dates and counts on a neutral ink wash. They turn red only when the thing is due or overdue, green only when a count is complete.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.24 0.02 285) 8%, transparent); color: oklch(0.24 0.02 285); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip.due { background: oklch(0.55 0.195 22); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 95); }

components.name: Filled Input
components.description: A field is a block: filled, no border, 44px minimum. Focus draws a 3px ring in the section's mark instead of changing an edge.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Say it here, let it go">
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.995 0.003 95); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--mark) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Dial
components.description: The ring sits on a circular surface fill so it reads as a round button. It rests at 72% ink and travels while running: red to green riding out a craving, ink to green across a study block.
components.html: <svg class="ds-dial" viewBox="0 0 96 96"><circle class="track" cx="48" cy="48" r="40"/><circle class="prog" cx="48" cy="48" r="40"/><text x="48" y="53" text-anchor="middle">4:32</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-dial { width: 104px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.995 0.003 95); cursor: pointer; pointer-events: bounding-box; } .ds-dial .track { fill: none; stroke: color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 12%, transparent); stroke-width: 8; } .ds-dial .prog { fill: none; stroke: var(--ring-stroke, var(--mark)); stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; transform: rotate(-90deg); transform-origin: 48px 48px; transition: stroke-dashoffset 1s linear; }

components.name: Focus Takeover
components.description: A running timer becomes the page: the dial grows to 42-52vh with a 3px stroke, a canvas field of motes drifts behind it and intensifies with progress, and the rest of the day drops to 12-30% opacity rather than disappearing.
components.css: .page:has(.session-running) .grid > section { opacity: 0.12; filter: saturate(0.15); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .page:has(.session-running) .grid > section:has(.session-running) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1 / -1; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5; opacity: 1; filter: none; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 86%, transparent); justify-content: center; } .station.session-running .ring-timer-lg { width: min(42vh, 320px); height: auto; } .station.session-running .ring-progress { stroke-width: 3; }

narrative.overview: Everything on this page is a solid object you can hit. No rules, hairlines, dividers or underlines: separation comes from gaps between filled blocks. The page is neutral, with exactly two colours, both of which name an outcome: green is kept, red is a slip or a deadline. Headings are 20px, body is 16px, nothing interactive is under 44px.
keyCharacteristics: Zero hairlines, rules, dividers or underlines. Gaps and fills only.
Every element is a block with real padding and a 14px radius.
One neutral field tone for every section on every page.
Two colours in the whole product: green is kept, red is a slip or a deadline.
Headings 20px sentence case, body 16px, minimum target 44px.
A running timer takes the whole stage; the rest of the day is quietened to 12-30%, never hidden.
rules: The Two Colours Rule. Green and red are the entire palette and both name an outcome. If a new element wants colour, ask which outcome it reports; if none, it is neutral.
The Earned Saturation Rule. Full chroma only on a state the user caused or a deadline that is genuinely close.
The Tinted Neutral Rule. No pure white, no pure black; every neutral carries a trace of warmth.
The Label Is A Heading Rule. Section titles are 20px sentence-case headings, never uppercase micro-labels.
The State Is The Block Rule. A control shows its state by filling entirely, not by marking a corner.
dos: Do make everything a block with a fill, a radius, and 44px of height.
Do keep sections neutral and let headings and position separate them.
Do set section headings at 20px sentence case.
Do show state by filling the whole control.
Do reserve green for kept and red for slipped or due, nothing else.
donts: Don't add a rule, hairline, divider, underline or side stripe.
Don't put a block inside a block, or a border on anything.
Don't introduce a third colour, or give a section a hue of its own.
Don't use colour for anything that isn't an outcome: kept, slipped, due.
Don't shrink a label below 0.75rem or set one in uppercase tracking.
